title: Ms
incidentLocation: Emergency Unit, University Hospital of Wales, Heath Park, Cardiff
incidentSummary: I slipped on wet steps and fell on my outstretched right hand. A&E X-rayed my wrist, said it was a sprain and sent me home with a bandage and no follow-up. The pain did not go away. Weeks later a repeat X-ray and MRI showed a scaphoid fracture that has not healed, and I now need surgery. I have missed class tests and weeks of shifts at my café job.

events.what: Fell on outstretched right hand; Emergency Unit at University Hospital of Wales X-rayed the wrist, said sprain, discharged with no follow-up
GP sent me for a repeat X-ray and MRI
MRI showed a displaced scaphoid waist fracture that has not healed; surgery planned

desiredOutcome: An explanation, an apology, changes to how A&E checks wrist injuries, and compensation for pain and lost earnings
